flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm,hook/useSearch,hook/useSearchParams}, utils/validation/NoticeSearch/ValidNoticeSearchAll, pages/Report/{index,action/ActionReport,lists/ReportList}; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/courtmention only in the authorization list). No code in ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui.
note: The story asks the Court Processing Officer to indicate a future court mention date so that OCMS generates a report from it. Only a notice search filter on a Court Mention Date range exists; there is no date input for a report, no report driven by the date, and no future-date validation. The story status is blank in stories.json, so the requirement is not given; traced normally. The server side of /v1/courtmention cannot be verified from the repo. CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info) is not credited: those are inbound endpoints for CAS/PLUS, not a check run by the Court Processing Officer.
recommendation: Claim only the Court Mention Date filter in Notice Search. A date input for a report and the report generation are not built.

steps.step: Officer enters a (future) court mention date as report parameter
steps.detail: Only the Court Mention Date From/To filter in the staff portal Notice Search exists: the form (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:318-360) and the range validation (ValidNoticeSearchAll.ts:61-82). It is a notice search filter, not a report parameter, and there is no 'must be a future date' rule.

steps.step: OCMS uses the date to fetch the cases scheduled on that date
steps.detail: useSearch.getNoticesByCourtMention calls GET courtmention with mention_date[$gte]/[$lte] (useSearch.ts:99-113, invoked in useSearchParams.tsx:232-241). The /v1/courtmention resource only appears in the authorization list (api-authorization.properties:23); there is no courtmention controller, entity or repository in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi/thirdpartyapi (grep courtmention, court_mention, mentionDate). The server side and its table therefore cannot be verified from the repo; a CRUD gateway outside the repo may provide it.

steps.step: OCMS generates the report based on the indicated date
steps.detail: No code generates a court report from the mention date. Report/index.tsx:61-76 only declares 4 titles (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) with path ""; their resource is commented out (ActionReport.tsx:33-62); they are not rendered in ReportList.tsx:11-32; there is no court report controller in ocmsadminapi/workflows/reports (only daily, agency mha/ps/toppan, system rip/notification/noticecreated/plusnotification/hst).
